The Pot is held and paid out in ORE: whatever comes in as SOL or SKR is swapped to ORE via Jupiter when the week is paid. The pot is funded by activity, not by minting new promises — it only ever pays out what the arena actually took in. Verify the draw ↗

Where every coin pack & mining tip goes

  • 22% → this weekly Pot — players win it back in the draw.
  • 22% → the Degen Dojo Reserve.
  • 44% → the preacher who brought the player in: 28% Wanderer · 36% Disciple · 44% Sensei (by fighters held). Whatever their tier doesn’t take — or all 44% when nobody referred the player — goes to the Reserve.
  • 12% → running the Dojo (hosting, tools, the team).

A mining tip that comes without a preacher goes 100% to the Reserve.

Marketplace royalties no longer feed the Pot: every royalty is split 88% to the collection’s Card Vault · 12% to running the Dojo. Become a preacher ↗

How you earn chances

  • Connect your wallet and play any game — every play mints you 1 chance 🎟 in this week's pot.
  • Win and you earn more: a win in Cluck-Fu, Cock Brawl or Dojo Flip is worth 3 chances, a Degen Duel win 2 (it's a skill game), and a loss still gives 1.
  • Chances stack all week. The more you play, the bigger your slice of the draw.
1 play = 1 chancewin = up to 3 chanceschances stack

How winners are picked

  • Winners are drawn weighted by chances — more chances, better odds — but every entry can win.
  • The pot splits among multiple winners; a bigger pot pays more winners so it always feels winnable.
  • Payouts land straight in your wallet. Unclaimed dust rolls into next week.

✅ Provably fair — verify it yourself

Before the draw we commit a secret seed. The winners are decided by an unpredictable future Solana blockhash mixed with that seed — a value nobody controls, not even Degen Dojo. After the draw we reveal the seed so anyone can re-run the exact pick and confirm the result.
